messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: On-call gap detected for upcoming holiday window. Primary: Priya R. (APAC), Secondary: <none assigned>. Shift: 2026-12-24 20:00 UTC -> 2026-12-26 08:00 UTC. Auto-escalation window: 10m. Please confirm deputy or update rota. https://redwood.internal/rotations
Priya R.: ack, I'm primary but I need a secondary for overlap with EU morning. I have limited availability 2026-12-25 02:00-10:00 UTC (family). Can someone take secondary or pair shadow?
Noah: I can take secondary for the first 12h (20:00-08:00 UTC) but then need to hand off to a EU person. I'm in APAC timezone but can cover the start.
Sam: I can do the EU morning handoff (from 08:00 UTC) but I'm traveling and might be slow to join the bridge if pager goes off. Prefer to be deputy, not primary.
Priya R.: ideal plan: Noah as deputy for first half, Sam as deputy for second. We need a bridge + runbook pinned. Also anyone able to be async backup for major pager?
Leila: I can be async backup for the whole window (will watch DMs). If something needs real-time debugging I might be delayed ~20-30m.
Priya R.: ok great — @Noah do you confirm? @Sam confirm? I'll update rotation once both confirm.
Noah: confirmed. I'll join bridge and take primary pager for first 12h. If I get paged, I'll follow runbook below and escalate to Priya if not resolved in 15m.
Sam: confirmed for second half. I'll be on-call standby and can jump onto bridge within 10m once alerted.
OpsBot: New temporary oncall mapping created: primary=Priya R., deputy1=Noah, deputy2=Sam, async_backup=Leila. Rota updated: https://redwood.internal/rotations/holiday-2026
Priya R.: copying runbook excerpt here for quick access:
```
Handoff checklist (short)
1) Confirm primary/deputy listed in rota
2) Start Zoom bridge: zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: redwood)
3) Open runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/payment-degradation
4) Check prometheus alert groups: payments_high_latency, kv_cache_errors
5) If customer impact > 0.5% traffic, page eng-sre and product-ops
6) Escalation timeline: 10m -> deputy, 20m -> primary, 30m -> paging rule -> oncall-lead
```
Priya R.: quick note — current PagerDuty incidents: none. But metric spike seen in eu-payments latency alert (investigate if it repeats). If the spike becomes sustained, we need to create an incident channel and attach customer impact summary.
Noah: copied. If paged I'll first run this triage snippet: 
```
curl -sS https://monitoring.internal/api/alerts?service=payments | jq '.[] | {id, severity, value}'
# check redis latency
redis-cli -h payments-redis-1 latency latest
# tail logs
kubectl logs -n payments -l app=payments -c api --tail=200
```
Sam: also add this to runbook for handoffs: include last 5 commits to payments service and any recent deploy tags — avoids chasing ghosts.
Leila: FYI customer-impact blurb template:
"At T, customers in EU may see increased payment latency (~X% error or Yms p95). Impacted flows: card charges, subscription renewals. Mitigation: failover to standby payment cluster in us-east if latency > threshold. Postmortem link: TBD."
Priya R.: good. I'll create the bridge now and post link.
Priya R.: Bridge started: zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: redwood). Channel created: #incident-handoff-holiday-2765433210. Paging policy confirmed: 10 min deputy escalation.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Bridge and channel detected. Incident channel: #incident-handoff-holiday-2765433210. Auto-attach runbook: payment-degradation.
Noah: leaving a quick note for whoever relieves me: if you see KV cache miss rate > 2x baseline, scale read-replicas and check new nodes for high interrupt Q. Escalate to infra if scaling fails.
Sam: will take over at 08:00 UTC. I'll watch the channel from 07:50 and take primary pager at 08:00. If anything hits before that, @Noah handle until handoff.
Priya R.: thanks team. If anything emergent, page me and I'll land on the bridge. Otherwise I'll run the post-window checklist and mark rota clear after 08:00 UTC on 2026-12-26. :pray:
